name: 萌宠条纹四季百搭服饰款
description: 棉质条纹狗狗四季服，透气亲肤，条纹相间百搭，四季可穿

styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat misty blue #B7CFD9 panels alternating with clean white #FFFFFF cards and rounded-corner photo frames
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front key, gentle contact shadows, no harsh specular
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte studio backdrop; light wood floor and beige fabric sofa for home scene shots
styleLock.typography: playful rounded hand-drawn display headlines with white outline, clean sans-serif labels, one family only; Chinese in-image text wrapped in 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: thin hand-drawn doodle squiggle lines, paw motifs, circular check badges, thin leader lines
styleLock.presentationRules: garment always shown worn by a generic small dog model, centered stable scale, full garment visible, no face close-up dependency
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cute pet-apparel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty blue background #B7CFD9, clean white panels #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D, deep navy accent #223A5E; cool neutral tone; playful rounded hand-drawn display headline style with doodle squiggle accents and thin-line motifs; bright even high-key studio lighting with soft contact shadows; rounded-corner card layout system with pill-shaped section titles, circular check badges and thin leader lines; garment always shown worn by a generic small dog model with stable centered scale; clean breathing margins around every layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no real brand logos.

shots.background: seamless misty blue studio backdrop #B7CFD9 with minimal white hand-drawn doodle squiggle accents at upper corners
shots.textZone: top center headline zone; small pill label 「{callout_1}」 at upper left
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce hero photo of {product} worn by a generic small fluffy dog model, sitting centered and facing the camera. {product_identity_lock}. Purpose: win the search click with a cute clean look. Slight front 3/4 angle at eye level, full garment and dog visible, not clipped by frame, the dog and garment group filling 60-70% of the square frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, gentle contact shadow grounding the dog. provenance.notes: 9 张详情页切片提炼。源夹名仅给到 L1（宠物用品），与判定一致；L2=服饰 由图片判定（主产品为狗狗穿着的条纹棉质四季服）。已剥离：源图特定泰迪犬模特身份、店铺会员二维码贴片、手绘猫吉祥物专属插画、源文案原句。panel-03/04 的空圆角框与 panel-07/08 的空蓝实拍区均按通用分镜重建；panel-05 尺码表原为重复假数据，模板中改为 callout 占位由使用者填真实数据。补充了一个源图缺失的痛点对比分镜以完整转化漏斗。
